name: KisanGrow AI
tagline: Precision satellite & AI advisory for smallholder agricultural resilience
problem: Smallholder farmers in the Indus basin face 30% yield loss due to inaccurate weather, water stress, and pest prediction.
solution: Affordable Urdu-language mobile app and WhatsApp bot that analyzes hyperspectral satellite imagery to provide daily localized micro-action recommendations.
traction: 45,000 registered farmers across Punjab & Sindh, 18% month-over-month active user growth, $12.5k MRR via B2B fertilizer partnerships.
pitch_summary: Empowering 10M farmers across South Asia with localized satellite AI intelligence to increase crop yield by 24% while cutting water usage.

name: DawaaConnect
tagline: B2B pharmaceutical procurement and credit network for independent pharmacies
problem: 90% of neighborhood pharmacies suffer from stockouts, counterfeit medicines, and predatory informal supplier credit.
solution: Digital ordering marketplace direct from licensed manufacturers with integrated 30-day working capital micro-credit.
traction: Serving 1,200 pharmacies in Lahore and Karachi, processing $450k GMV per month with 99.2% on-time credit repayment.
pitch_summary: Digitizing Pakistan's $4B retail pharmaceutical supply chain through verified distribution and embedded working capital financing.

name: LedgerSync
tagline: AI CFO and tax compliance automation for Pakistani SMBs and freelancers

founders.name: Usman Tariq
founders.background: Ex-PwC Senior Auditor, Self-taught Fullstack Dev

problem: Over 2 million SMBs and 500k IT freelancers struggle with FBR tax filing, cross-border remittance compliance, and bookkeeping.
solution: Automated ledger that connects to Pakistani bank APIs, WhatsApp receipt scanning, and generates 1-click compliant FBR withholding and tax returns.
traction: 2,800 active freelancers and 220 SMBs subscribed; zero churn over last 3 months.
pitch_summary: The all-in-one financial operating system for South Asian creators, exporters, and SMBs to automate bookkeeping and FBR compliance.
